RawPostStudyStage.description:
One post-horizon calendar stage: a `[start_date, start_date + duration_hours)`
segment. `end_date` is not declared; it is derived downstream.

duration_hours.description: Stage duration \[h\]. Must be finite and `> 0.0`.

start_date.description: Stage start date (inclusive), as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD).

RawPostStudyThermalBound.description: Cost and generation bounds for one `(thermal, post-study stage)` cell.

cost_per_mwh.description: Fuel cost (`$/MWh`) at this cell. Must be finite.

max_mw.description:
Upper bound of the delivered MW rate at this cell. Must be finite and
`>= min_mw`.

min_mw.description: Lower bound of the delivered MW rate at this cell. Must be finite.

thermal_id.description: Thermal plant identifier. Must reference an anticipated thermal.
